scenarios.title: Normal execution
scenarios.goal: Inspect a synthetic base-and-sphere workflow with scene readback and geometry assertions.
scenarios.input: Create a 20x20x2 base at the origin, then center a red sphere of radius 8 on its top face.
expected: The sphere is centered on and touches the top of the base

asserts.label: Sphere position
asserts.expected_text: Center [0,0,10]; bottom touches the base top with XY alignment

scenarios.title: Self-correction
scenarios.goal: Inspect a synthetic mismatch, targeted size and color correction, scene re-read, and independent checks.
scenarios.input: Create a blue sphere, read the scene, and correct any mismatch to radius 12 and RGB 0/0/255 before verifying again.
expected: The first assertions show size and color mismatches
Correction updates the sphere without creating a duplicate
The final checks confirm 24×24×24 bounds and blue color

evidence.label: P0 synthetic correction chain and evidence

scenarios.title: Privacy and routing
scenarios.goal: Inspect synthetic email minimization before model routing, with an auditable decision trail.
scenarios.input: Remove the contact email contact@example.invalid from cloud requests, then create a 60x40x4 tabletop and four 4x4x30 legs and group them.
expected: Privacy risk is medium and the action is minimize_cloud
Browser and model payloads show only <EMAIL_REDACTED>
Routing, tools, assertions, and metrics share the replay-table run_id

asserts.label: Table member count
asserts.expected_text: Five table components in the empty demo document

asserts.label: Group completeness
asserts.expected_text: All five components belong to one synthetic group
